title: Lamb Casserole alla Italiana
description: A hearty, comforting Italian-inspired lamb casserole with a rich, warm, and malty flavor.
instructions: Season the lamb cubes with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb cubes on all sides, then remove from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped carrots, and chopped celery to the pot.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened and lightly browned.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes, red wine, beef broth, and tomato paste to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the browned lamb cubes to the pot and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
